# Devang Padhiyar

> Senior Software Engineer (remote) at Simplified, TLDR Technologies Inc. — building LLM-powered video agents, fully agentic pipelines, and end-to-end agent orchestration. Backend-heavy generalist with a decade of production experience across Python, TypeScript, Django, React, and multi-cloud.

## What I'm working on

- **LLM-powered video agents** — AI-driven video generation, repurposing, and subtitle workflows.
- **Fully agentic pipelines** — end-to-end, stateful multi-step agent orchestration with LangGraph.
- **In-app AI copilots** — user-facing copilots with CopilotKit for media workflows.
- **Prompt engineering & evaluation** — systematic prompt optimization with eval harnesses for production LLM features.
- **Agentic coding workflows** — full automation of coding pipelines (code gen, PR review, test authoring, CI/CD) with Claude Code and Cursor.

## AI / LLM stack

- Models: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Stability AI
- Frameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, CopilotKit
- Protocols: MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Tooling: Claude Code, Cursor

## Core engineering stack

- Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, C++
- Backend: Django, Celery, GraphQL, Express.js
- Frontend: React, Fabric.js
- Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ
- Cloud: AWS, GCP, Azure, DigitalOcean
- Media: FFmpeg, OpenCV
